scripts.build:firebase: npx vite build --mode firebase --config vite.config.js && cp dist-firebase/cloud_chamber/vitalos/index.html dist-firebase/index.html
scripts.deploy:shell: npm run build:firebase && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:fitness: npx vite build --config ../federation/fitness.remote.vite.config.js && firebase deploy --only hosting --config ../fitness-dev/firebase.json
scripts.deploy:fuel: npx vite build --config ../federation/fuel.remote.vite.config.js && firebase deploy --only hosting --config ../federation/firebase.fuel.json
scripts.deploy:journal: npx vite build --config ../federation/journal.remote.vite.config.js && firebase deploy --only hosting --config ../journal-dev/firebase.remote.json
scripts.deploy:learn: npx vite build --config ../federation/learn.remote.vite.config.js && firebase deploy --only hosting --config ../learn-dev/firebase.remote.json
